whoItsFor: Developers using a coding assistant (Claude Code and similar) who get lost in long, verbose answers and want direct, step-by-step output. It is an agent skill, so it fits anyone who installs it as a plugin rather than a standalone tool.
useCases: Get the next action first, with numbered steps for multi-step tasks
Cut preamble, recaps, and closing pleasantries from coding-agent replies
Keep answers focused by suppressing tangents and capping lists at five items
installCommand: Install the i-have-adhd skill/plugin from https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd, refer to the repo's AGENTS.md for instructions.
